description: Ministry of Justice and Labour Relations - Order to specify that the monetary value of the subject matter within the Special Mediation Boards Area shall be less that Rs. 2,000,000 - The Mediation (Qualifications of Mediators) Regulations of 2015
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the Minister of Justice and Labour Relations making regulations and orders under the Mediation (Special Categories of Disputes) Act, No. 21 of 2003. It specifies monetary thresholds for disputes and establishes qualifications for mediators. This constitutes regulatory matters and legal framework implementation, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, it does so in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not as a personnel appointment or portfolio assignment.
